newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not established, but a lower undertone was noted, USDA said. Dressed Basis Delivered. (paid on hot carcass weights)
Dressed Basis Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 113.00-113.50. (weighted average 113.13)
Dressed Basis Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 113.00.
Prices on slaughter steers and heifers not established. Trade slow. Buyer interest very light, some off the market. Seller interest light.
Live basis sales: Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1350 lbs
Wk To Date: 3,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk: 12,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr: 87,200
